messages:
Priya Raman: kicking off activation for Verdant (new pilot) — want a quick sync to align stakeholders, success criteria, and timing. can we confirm owners?
Ben Cho: +1. i can own the integration workshop and basic infra checklist.
Omar Diaz: i'll own commercial touchpoints and renewal risk flagging. when's the first customer kickoff meeting?
onboarding-bot: Meeting created: Verdant Onboard Kickoff — Wed Mar 04 10:00am PT (Google Meet). Attendees: Priya, Ben, Jordan, Omar, Maya. Link: https://meet.example/verdant-kickoff
Jordan Lee: sharing the customer's stated goals from discovery: 
- 90% reduction in query latency for search suggestions
- embeddings for similarity search across 3m docs
- SOC2 adjacencies, need to review dataflow
Maya Patel: enablement ask: want a 60–90m product walkthrough + 30m admin setup for the product team. can we schedule week 1?
Priya Raman: proposed success criteria (short):
- end-to-end demo with live data ingest (test bucket) by day 10
- perf baseline < 250ms p95 for 512-token prompts in staging by day 21
- first embedding ingestion + search validation by day 14
- enablement session completed and internal docs handed off by day 7
Ben Cho: tech plan: integration workshop (2hrs), staging creds, sample dataset (s3://verdant-sample). i'll send a prep checklist tonight.
Omar Diaz: risks: data residency questions, SSO not ready, possible delays if security review takes >2 weeks. mark renewal at-risk if >30d delay in production.
Jordan Lee: timeline acked. i'll draft a 30/60/90-facing deck and success metrics dashboard.
Maya Patel: can we get a recording of the product walkthrough for their enablement folks who can't make the live?
Priya Raman: yes, recording + notes. owners: integration = Ben, enablement = Maya, customer ops = Jordan, commercial = Omar, overall CSM = Priya.
Ben Cho: task list i'll create in the customer board: integration checklist, sample dataset upload, staging endpoint + test run. ETA for items: checklist tonight, dataset by Tue EOD.
Omar Diaz: i'll send the contract amendment for the pilot timeline and note renewal checkpoints.
Jordan Lee: will prepare the dashboard template and sample queries. need vendor table access — Priya can you request?
Priya Raman: done — requested vendor access, CC'd their security contact.
onboarding-bot: Reminder set: Kickoff in 2 days.
Maya Patel: i'll propose two slots for the walkthrough in the calendar invite, leaning toward Thu morning.
Priya Raman: perfect. quick Q: any blockers from our side?
Ben Cho: none yet. will surface if staging GPU quota is limited.
Omar Diaz: i'm good.
Jordan Lee: all good here.
Priya Raman: ok — next steps: Ben to post checklist, Maya to schedule walkthrough, Jordan to prep deck, Omar to handle contract notes. we'll do the kickoff meeting and then a follow-up 7-day status post. :rocket:
